title: "CoHOLSER for Ruxolitin and Ulexertinib combinaiton treatment compare to single treatments and control"
output: html_document

---

## Load Library
```{r, eval=FALSE, echo =FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(rpx)
library(msdata)
library(Spectra)
library(tidyverse)
library(cleaver)
library(MSnbase)
library(tidyverse)
library(mzR)
library(PSMatch)
library(pheatmap)
library(QFeatures)
library(sageR)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(factoextra)
library(limma)
library(DEP)
library(ggrepel)
library(data.table)
```

## 1. Read evidence.txt
```{r}
library(data.table)
evidence <- read_tsv("~/Documents/CoHOLSER/run004.2_summary/run004.2_summary/evidence.txt", show_col_types = FALSE)

```

## 2. Identify TMT reporter intensity columns
```{r}
tmt_cols <- grep("^Reporter intensity corrected", colnames(evidence), value = TRUE)

## Optional: remove rows with all-zero reporter intensities
evidence <- evidence[rowSums(as.matrix(evidence[, tmt_cols, with = FALSE])) > 0, ]

```

## 3. Build assay matrix
```{r}
assay_mat <- as.matrix(evidence[, tmt_cols, with = FALSE])
mode(assay_mat) <- "numeric"
```

## Clean sample names
```{r}
colnames(assay_mat) <- str_replace(tmt_cols, "Reporter intensity corrected ", "TMT")

```

## 5. Build rowData

```{r}
row_data <- DataFrame(
  Sequence        = evidence$Sequence,
  ModifiedSeq     = evidence$`Modified sequence`,
  Proteins        = evidence$Proteins,
  LeadingProtein  = evidence$`Leading proteins`,
  GeneNames       = evidence$`Gene names`,
  Charge          = evidence$Charge,
  PEP             = evidence$PEP,
  Score           = evidence$Score,
  RawFile         = evidence$`Raw file`,
  Reverse         = evidence$Reverse,
  Contaminant     = evidence$`Potential contaminant`
)
rownames(row_data) <- evidence$id
```

## 6. Build colData

```{r}
col_data <- DataFrame(TMT_channel = colnames(assay_mat))
rownames(col_data) <- colnames(assay_mat)
```

## 7. Create SummarizedExperiment

```{r}
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays  = list(intensity = assay_mat),
  rowData = row_data,
  colData = col_data
)
```

## 8. Convert to QFeatures
```{r}
qf <- QFeatures()
qf[["psm"]] <- se

```

## Inspect
```{r}
qf
```
